'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[United Methodist Church]] ratifies a constitutional amendment restructuring the denomination, enabling each region of the church worldwide to have equal autonomy. Other amendments involve expanding membership allowances to account for gender and ability, and condemning [[white supremacy]] and [[colonialism]]. [https://www.umnews.org/en/news/church-strengthens-stands-on-inclusion-racism?fbclid=IwZnRzaAN5AatleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZAo2NjI4NTY4Mzc5AAEeHbe-wdhZVzIj99vw2e2HT9LLIjjPNQ3PzWY6Z9JKkANL8wHZx-zqTUuL89E_aem_8qe5z4lPEjpdLyJkKBhWLg (UMNews)] [https://www.tennessean.com/story/news/religion/2025/11/05/umc-restructuring-vote-results/87069417007/# (''The Tennessean'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Typhoon Kalmaegi]]'s impact on [[Visayas]] and [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]], rises to at least 114, with [[search and rescue]] operations ongoing. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/typhoon-kalmaegi-philippines-9.6967346 (AP via CBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/typhoon-kalmaegi-kills-least-58-philippines-heads-toward-vietnam-2025-11-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 United States listeriosis outbreak]]
**An outbreak of [[listeriosis]] linked to [[product recall|recalled]] [[pasta]] products in 18 [[States of the United States|U.S. states]] kills at least six people and causes 25 hospitalizations. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/04/nx-s1-5598279/listeria-outbreak-prepared-pasta (NPR)] [https://www.health.com/pasta-meals-recall-november-2025-11843314 (''Health'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2019 Bolivian political crisis]]
**[[Bolivia]]'s [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice of Bolivia|Supreme Court]] overturns the 10-year [[Prisons in Bolivia|prison]] sentence of former [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Jeanine Áñez]], ruling that she should have been tried by a [[Extraordinary court|special judicial body]] responsible for cases involving officials and ordering her release. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251105-bolivia-supreme-court-orders-release-of-jailed-ex-president-jeanine-anez (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2025 Island of Oléron car ramming]]
**Five people are injured, two critically, in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] on the [[France|French]] island of [[Oléron]]. The perpetrator attempts to set the car [[Arson|on fire]], before being arrested by the [[National Gendarmerie|gendarmerie]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/05/car-french-island-ile-d-oleron-france (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Human rights in Malaysia]]
**A [[Malaysia]]n [[High court (Malaysia)|high court]] rules that [[Royal Malaysia Police|police]] and [[Second Najib cabinet|the government]] are responsible for the [[enforced disappearances]] of activist [[Amri Che Mat]] and pastor [[Raymond Koh]] in 2016 and 2017, respectively, ordering investigations to be reopened and awarding [[damages]] exceeding [[Malaysian ringgit|RM]] 33 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]8 million) to their families. The decision marks the first judicial finding of state involvement in enforced disappearances in Malaysia. [https://apnews.com/article/malaysia-religious-abduction-enforced-disappearance-dcd95173a461162fd382b8f31abd2e31 (AP)]
*A [[Judiciary of Germany|court]] in [[Aachen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]], sentences a 44-year-old [[palliative care]] nurse to [[Life imprisonment in Germany|life imprisonment]] for [[Murder in German law|murdering]] 10 patients and attempting to murder 27 others with [[lethal injection]]s at a hospital in [[Würselen]] between December 2023 and May 2024. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nurse-life-sentence-murder-10-patients-germany/ (AFP via CBS News)]
*[[Japan]]ese [[Minister of Defense (Japan)|defense minister]] [[Shinjirō Koizumi|Shinjiro Koizumi]] says that [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|troops]] were sent to [[Akita Prefecture]] after a series of more than 50 [[bear attack]]s since April, which resulted in 12 deaths and over 100 injuries. [[Governor (Japan)|Governor]] {{ill|Kenta Suzuki|ja|鈴木健太 (政治家)}} requested aid, saying that local authorities lack manpower to handle the situation. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-bear-attack-army-12a2a3233790deeefd9ec379d0121f33 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Japan]]ese-born [[Tomio Okamura]] of the [[Freedom and Direct Democracy]] party is elected [[President of the Chamber of Deputies (Czech Republic)|president]] of the [[Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Republic|Chamber of Deputies]] of the [[Czech Republic]], marking the first major appointment under [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic|prime minister]]-designate [[Andrej Babiš]]'s new [[coalition government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/czech-lower-house-elects-far-right-party-leader-speaker-2025-11-05/ (Reuters)]
